learning_outcomes.text: Understand Data coding, markup languages, XML.
Understand the Network layer, communication protocols, TCP/IP suite.

syllabus_topics: Introduction. Meanings of Information. Information measure. Uncertainty, Entropy, Transinformation.
Communication channel, signal, noise. Discrete channel, capacity, noise.
Continuous channel. Logarithmic scale units used in telecommunication.
Coding. Theory, classification. Optimal codes, data compression. Error detection and correction codes.
Data coding. Coding of numbers and texts. Unicode. Markup languages, XML.
Cryptography. Public key infrastructure. Certification authority.
ISO/OSI reference model. TCP/IP architecture. Transmission media.
Transmission line. Structured cabling.
Baseband and broadband cabling. Data coding, Modulation.
Optical transmission. Wireless transmission.
Data link layer. Frames. MAC addresses. LAN technologies.
Network layer. Routing, TCP/IP protocol suite.
Digitization of analog data. Pulse code modulation (G.711). Voice over IP.
Quantum information, quantum computing. Genetic information, genetic code.
Introduction. Communication channel. OSI reference model.
Transmission line. Metallic cabling.
Optical cabling, wireless transmission.
Data link layer. Serial communication.
Network layer. Communication protocols. TCP/IP architecture.
Securing information. Cryptography.
Application protocols. Typical Examples.
